  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `gh issue view` failures are swallowed, so the latch verification reports `::error::FAILED to latch` when the real problem may be API/network/scope failure rather than a missing label.
  WHY: All four reviewers note that `|| true` plus `grep -qxF` collapses transient GitHub API errors into the same "label absent" path and can mislead operators.

  WHY: A transient GitHub API failure during verification can produce a false negative error even if the label was successfully applied.
